newsitem.title: USA: Whitman Education names new regional heads.
newsitem.headline: Whitman Education names new regional heads.

text.p: Whitman Education Group Inc said on Thursday that Gary Camp had been appointed as president of the northern region of its newly created Associate Degree Division.

Camp, who previously served as vice president of marketing for the company's Ultrasound Diagnostic Schools unit, will be responsible for the operations of eight northern UDS schools, Whitman said in a statement.
In addition, the company said, Joyce Meadows was appointed president of the division's southern region and C. Ronald Kimberling has been appointed as the president of the central region.
Whitman said it had reorganized operations into two divisions: the University Degree Division and the Associate Degree Division.

The University Degree Division grants degrees in business, computer science and engineering and consists of the operations of Colorado Technical University and Huron University and is headed by David O'Donnell, Whitman said.
The Associate Degree Division consists of the operations of Sanford-Brown College and its Ultrasound Diagnostic Schools.
Whitman Education Group Inc is a proprietary provider of career-oriented postsecondary education that operates 24 schools in 13 states.
